channel.title: Lisper.ru: clbuild не качается из darcs
channel.description:
λ darcs get http://common-lisp.net/project/clbuild/clbuild
Converting old-fashioned repository to hashed format...
*******************************************************************************
Fetching a hashed repository would be faster.  Perhaps you could persuade
the maintainer to run darcs optimize --upgrade with darcs 2.4.0 or higher?
*******************************************************************************
                                    
                                    
Warning: CRC errors found. These are probably harmless but should be repaired.
See 'darcs gzcrcs --help' for more information.

darcs: unable to read patch:
Wed Oct 22 21:05:32 BST 2008  Albert Krewinkel
  * Added projects by Cyrus Harmon.
Couldn't parse file http://common-lisp.net/project/clbuild/clbuild/_darcs/patches/20081022200532-28082-ad194ee145730dd766b9950741df3c1ccc07a265.gz

 λ darcs --version
2.4 (release)

Это у всех так, или только у меня? Может кто нибудь тарбол расшарить?
